incident-bot: :rotating_light: realtime-latency-detector alert: p95 for /v1/generate in us-east-1 breached SLO threshold (3.1x over baseline). alert_id=latency-1934571234
Priya (SRE): I'm on it. Any customer reports yet?
Support Nina: getting a spike in tickets mentioning "very slow responses" starting ~15:02 UTC. Affected customers spread across trial and standard tiers.
Marcus (Ops): dashboards show p95 ~1.3s (baseline 400ms), p99 ~5.2s. Streaming sessions show intermittent stalls >3s. Link: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/latency?region=us-east-1
Lina (ML): no model promotions in the last 24h. Could this be sudden batching change or queueing?
Ezra (Eng): checking ingress logs and queue lengths. Running: `kubectl get hpa -n runtime` then `kubectl logs -l app=ingress -n runtime --tail=200`
Priya (SRE): paging oncall @Priya (SRE) and @Marcus (Ops). Also tagging @Lina for potential model/runtime interactions.
incident-bot: created incident INC-2026-1934571234 severity=sev2.
Marcus (Ops): I see an autoscaler activity at 15:05 that scaled down GPU pool us-east-gpu-pool-1 by 3 nodes due to CPU-based metric. That probably reduced headroom. Command: `infractl events --since 15:00 --nodepool us-east-gpu-pool-1`
Priya (SRE): rolling mitigation plan: 1) prevent further scale-downs, 2) force-scale up nodes, 3) reduce max batch wait to 40ms in runtime config, canary to 20% then roll. Prefer not to fail over region.
Lina (ML): agree, changing region routing would increase latency for many. Also will monitor KV cache hit rates and batch sizes.
Ezra (Eng): initiating scale up: `infractl scale --nodepool us-east-gpu-pool-1 --add 5` (requested).
Marcus (Ops): pausing autoscaler: `infractl autoscaler update --nodepool us-east-gpu-pool-1 --min=4` (set min to current+3).
Priya (SRE): applying runtime config change (canary to 15% first): `redwoodctl set runtime.config max_batch_wait_ms=40 --region=us-east-1 --percent=15`
incident-bot: note: runtime config change queued; canary rollout started at 15:11 UTC.
Support Nina: updated customers: "We're investigating elevated latencies in us-east-1; mitigation in progress. We'll update shortly."
Marcus (Ops): scale-up job in progress; nodes reported provisioning. ETA ~5-8min.
Priya (SRE): quick smoke: check active streaming connections and backpressure logs. `grep -i "stall" /var/log/runtime/* | tail -n 50` -> shows many entries around 15:03-15:10 with durations 1.2s-6.5s.
Lina (ML): after canary (15%) applied, initial metrics show p95 down to ~850ms within 2 minutes. p99 still high ~3.2s.
Ezra (Eng): canary to 50% now as telemetry looks good. rolling: 15% -> 50%
incident-bot: metric snapshot: pre-change p95(5m)=1300ms, p95(2m after)=780ms, p99 pre=5200ms p99 after=2100ms.
Support Nina: I'm cataloging affected customers and severity for outreach. 18 open tickets tagged latency-us-east.
Marcus (Ops): all new nodes joined cluster (5/5).
Priya (SRE): post-scale metrics at 15:22: p95=450ms, p99=600ms. Streaming stalls count dropped by 86% in logs.
Lina (ML): looking at batch histograms: before change mean batch wait 180ms on many pods. After change median wait ~35ms. That aligns. I'll follow up with proposal for adaptive batch caps.
Ezra (Eng): note: autoscaler policy misinterpreted CPU spike from kernel-side GC of a tooling process; will harden metric filters to exclude that process.
Priya (SRE): support, please send a customer update: "We observed elevated latency in us-east-1 between 15:02-15:20 UTC; mitigation applied and performance returned to normal. If you continue to see issues, please reopen your ticket."
Support Nina: sending update now.
incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: INC-2026-1934571234 status=mitigated timestamp=1934571460
Priya (SRE): marking mitigated but leaving incident open for postmortem. Assigning action items: Marcus to lock autoscaler thresholds, Lina to propose adaptive batching and KV cache heuristics, Ezra to update autoscaler filters and deploy monitoring alerts for sudden downscale events.
Lina (ML): I'll run traffic replay overnight and produce a dashboard showing batch wait distribution vs tail latency.
Marcus (Ops): I'll schedule a config change to autoscaler and test in staging.
Ezra (Eng): will follow up with a short write-up of the root-cause hypothesis and PR for filter change.
Support Nina: closing immediate tickets after confirmation from SRE.
Priya (SRE): thanks all. I'll create the incident doc and invite folks for a 60-min blameless postmortem tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
